subject: Fix incorrect use of "path" instead of "resolvedPath" when watching file's package json locations (#57931)

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: Resolution cache keyed impliedFormatPackageJsons by newFile.path instead of resolvedPath, so package.json watchers for files were created/updated incorrectly in watch mode.
